subject: POC environment steps, credential sprint & target close cadence
messages:
From: Sam Wright <sam.wright@healthcove.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick checklist for the POC environment (API keys, peering)

Sergio — thanks again for the demo this morning. Team is aligned to move forward with a 3-week POC, goal is to validate latency at 99th percentile and that API throughput scales for our ingest pipeline. To keep momentum, could you confirm the following items and an approximate timeline so I can sync with our infra and procurement teams?

- Org setup: we need a Redwood organization created with an evaluation seat for 4 engineers.
- API keys: per-environment keys (staging + prod-like) with rotation guidance.
- IP allowlist: our infra team will share a small set of static CIDRs. Can Redwood accept CIDR lists and apply to the staging pool?
- VPC peering: need a target window for peering and any expected downtime.
- SOW and billing: procurement asked for a draft SOW and ballpark pricing for a dedicated 2-week timebox.

I’ll attach our network diagram and procurement contact. If you can send a mutual action plan (MAP) with owners and due dates we can lock a kickoff next Tuesday.

Thanks —
Sam
Sam Wright
Head of Engineering, HealthCove
Attachments: healthcove-network-diagram.png (image)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sam Wright <sam.wright@healthcove.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-07T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick checklist for the POC environment (API keys, peering)

Sam — great to hear the team is ready. I pulled together a short MAP and a timeline (attached). High-level notes below; MAP spreadsheet will have owners and exact dates.

- Org & seats: we can provision a HealthCove org in our console and invite 4 engineers by EOD Friday. Owner: Marissa.
- API keys: generate two scoped API keys (staging + validation). We recommend short-lived keys + a service account for integration. Owner: Hannah.
- IP allowlist: we support CIDR blocks; send the range and we’ll apply to the staging pool. Expect propagation within 15 minutes. Owner: Hannah.
- VPC peering: standard peering across the us-west region. Suggested window: 11/12 02:00–04:00 PT (low traffic). No planned downtime; small routing convergence expected (~1–3 min). Owner: Networking team (we’ll coordinate).
- SOW & pricing: sending a draft SOW and a pricing worksheet for the 2-week evaluation. Owner: Marissa (finance looped).

I attached MAP-HealthCove-v1.xlsx and the SOW draft. If procurement needs a DocuSign link we can provide one after scope confirmation. Proposed kickoff: Tuesday 2025-11-11 at 10:00 PT (30m).

Quick ask for your infra team: please send the CIDR list + a contact for peering (VPN/VPC owner) so we can open the peering ticket.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-HealthCove-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-Redwood-draft.docx (doc)
From: Sam Wright <sam.wright@healthcove.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@healthcove.com>, Lara Kim <lara.kim@healthcove.com>
Date: 2025-11-07T14:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick checklist for the POC environment (API keys, peering)

Thanks — attaching the CIDRs and peering contact below. Procurement wants the SOW line items clarified on support and data handling; Lara (cc) will own that.

- CIDRs for staging allowlist: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/28
- Peering contact: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@healthcove.com>, VPN owner; prefers peering window 11/12 01:00–03:00 PT instead (slightly earlier).

We’ll review the MAP and suggest any edits. Procurement: can you confirm the PO cadence once we finalize scope?

— Sam
Attachments: healthcove-network-cidrs.txt (text)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-09T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: HealthCove MAP updates and prep for kickoff

Team — thread from HealthCove looks green. Short internal plan before kickoff: please review and ack the owners in the MAP tab. Key operational points:

- Org provisioning (Marissa): create org "healthcove-eval" and invite 4 engineers. Add folder with role-based access and link to the MAP spreadsheet. Target: 2025-11-10 12:00 PT.
- API keys (Hannah): create two scoped service keys; provide rotation guidance and an example SDK snippet (python) in the MAP. Target: 2025-11-10 16:00 PT. Include token TTL recommendation (30m) and a refresh flow.
- IP allowlist (Hannah): add 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.0/28 to staging pool; verify propagation and respond with traceroute sample to Rajesh. Target: 2025-11-11 09:00 PT.
- VPC peering (Ben): open peering ticket with infra; confirm route tables and BGP settings. HealthCove prefers window 11/12 01:00–03:00 PT; confirm acceptance or propose 02:00–04:00 PT. Include rollback steps. Target: 2025-11-11 17:00 PT.
- SOW & procurement (Marissa + Ben): finalize SOW line items about data retention and support SLA; provide DocuSign link for procurement. Target: 2025-11-11 12:00 PT.

Attachments in MAP: owners, due dates, acceptance criteria (latency target, sample payloads), contact list. I’ll send the calendar invite once owners ack. Quick responses please — kickoff Tuesday morning depends on these items.

Thanks —
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Internal attachment references: MAP-HealthCove-v1.xlsx, SOW-Redwood-draft.docx
